tagline: Curriculum Vitae — mathematician, software engineer, educator
summary: Mathematician and software engineer with a PhD in differential geometry and a decade of production experience. Published original research on rank rigidity; co-created and shipped a puzzle game rated 98% positive on Steam; architected a Python codebase that has run two community services continuously for ten years; and built a Bayesian rating and matchmaking system validated against held-out season data. Four years of university teaching, plus tutoring across mathematics, physics, and computer science.

card_blurb: Bayesian modeling, optimization, and PhD-level mathematics.
tagline: Quantitative engineer — Bayesian modeling, optimization, PhD mathematics
summary: PhD mathematician and software engineer who builds probabilistic models end to end. Across several seasons of a competitive league I built and refined a Bayesian paired-comparison rating system — deriving the gradients by hand, writing the optimizer, fitting a heavy-tailed link function and the prior variance to historical match data, calibrating against a known baseline, and modeling correlated rating uncertainty (which meant patching a C++ Bayesian Elo engine) — then scheduled matches with an integer program that maximizes the information each result provides. Ten years architecting and maintaining production Python services alongside it. Published original research in differential geometry. Seeking machine-learning, modeling, or quantitative engineering roles; open to internships and to relocation.

summary: Co-lead programmer and lead puzzle designer on Bean and Nothingness, a logic-puzzle game rated 98% positive from 198 Steam reviews. I work across the whole stack of a game: engine and state systems, editor tooling shipped to players, gameplay and entity logic, custom audio, and puzzle design — and I coordinated a distributed remote team from prototype to release. Specializing in challenging indie puzzle-games. PhD mathematician who reasons precisely about state, correctness, and complex systems, with a decade of production service and database work alongside.
